workarounds.symptom: session_status and list_sessions report a session waiting in an auto-retry backoff (429) as plain running: no typed wait or until
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(rpc): publish a typed retry wait on session_status and list_sessions. Target files: packages/coding-agent/src/core/agent-session.ts, packages/coding-agent/src/core/retry-wait.ts, packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/rpc-session-state-types.ts. A session sleeping in an auto-retry backoff now carries a typed wait instead of looking like plain work: - `session_status` (and every derived record) gains `waiting: { kind: "rate_limit" | "retry", attempt, maxAttempts, delayMs, until, error? }` while a `running` session sleeps ... (Ref: https://github.com/code-yeongyu/senpi/pull/7027)
